thread:
Omar B: hi @people-ops — sharing privately. i've had a diagnosis of delayed sleep phase disorder and it's been getting worse with our late standups and rotating oncall. asking for: 1) no meetings before 11:00am for 90 days, 2) oncall window shifted later in the day for my rotation (start 12:00 instead of 08:00), 3) permission to occasionally work late-night bursts with comp time next day. worried about midcycle review and don't want this to look like disengagement. can you advise next steps?

Lila - Manager: Omar thank you for telling us. i'm supportive and we can make schedule changes. we need some overlap with the team but can limit recurring meetings to after 11am. i'll take on any early triage duties for your rotation. please don't worry about review notes — we'll keep it factual.

Tess - People Ops: Omar — sorry you're dealing with this. we can do a time-limited accommodation and trial it for 90 days. typical flow: private intake, draft accommodation letter with exact dates/scope, update oncall rota, and mark review adjustments (extension or reweight). provider documentation optional but helpful. all medical info stays in HR's confidential file. ready to do a 20m intake today?

Omar B: thanks Lila and Tess. yes to a 20m intake. i prefer an extension of the review window rather than reweighting if possible. also curious if we can set an expectation for async updates when i miss early meetings.

Riley - HR: Omar — extension is doable. we usually offer 6-12 week trials then reassess; 90 days is fine. sample accommodations we can use: no recurring meetings before 11am, shift oncall start to 12:00 for rotations during the accommodation, explicit comp-time policy for late-night work, and a note to reviewers that a temporary schedule accommodation was in effect. wording will be factual only.

Marco: i can cover early standups and help move grooming to async on your block. also happy to take on any customer touchpoints that happen in the morning.

Tess - People Ops: draft template (we'll finalize on the call):

```
Accommodation plan (draft):
- Scope: temporary schedule accommodation for 90 days
- Meetings: no recurring internal meetings before 11:00am; core overlap daily 11:00-15:00
- Oncall: shift rotation window to start at 12:00 for Omar's assigned weeks; Lila/Marco cover early triage
- Work pattern: permit late-night focused work with pre-approved comp time (to be logged and approved by manager)
- Performance: offer a 90-day trial with option to extend; extend midcycle review window by 6 weeks unless otherwise agreed
- Privacy: accommodation documented in confidential HR file; manager notes limited to factual dates and duties
```

Tess - People Ops: if that looks right i'll file the formal accommodation note, update the oncall rota, and mark the review extension. we'll keep the intake private.

Omar B: that template is perfect. i don't have a provider note right now but can get one later if needed. thanks for the comp-time idea — that helps. i'll take the 20m intake at 2pm.

Lila - Manager: i'll update the recurring meetings and swap triage duties for the first 2 rotations. i'll also add a calendar note for async updates and a handoff doc for oncall.

Riley - HR: next steps: 1) 20m private intake today to confirm dates and language, 2) People Ops drafts confidential accommodation letter, 3) manager updates meetings and oncall rota, 4) HR flags review extension in HRIS for calibration.

Omar B: appreciate everyone's help and discretion. DM'ing Tess to lock the time. :lock:
